description: This Java source file defines a LogFragment class, which is a fragment containing a LogView for displaying log data within an Android application. It manages the creation and configuration of UI components such as ScrollView and LogView, and updates the scroll position when log text changes.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that manages a LogView for displaying logs and handles view creation, layout, and auto-scrolling when log messages update.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, style, padding, and other visual properties, then returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Lifecycle method that inflates the views, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text changes, and returns the main view of the fragment.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
